column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these six tests need a real Python guest: they drive every way a wait on a promise can end (resolved, rejected, host error, timeout, fresh suspend) through the component boundary, and build a pre-0.5.0-shaped component to check it is refused by name -- which only executing a guest can show. Six WHOLE tests, none loops with t.Run, so there are no subtest names to ledger separately (cleat#3437 had two). Declared under all four keys that reject a new ./engine/ toolchain skip -- multi-db/mysql, multi-db/mssql, cluster, and test-go/engine (the last required by scripts/check-skips.sh's pairing rule; engine-race.yml is scheduled and does not run on PRs, so that count is the rule applied, not a reading of its report). Same mechanism as the sibling TestPythonGuest tests, measured on cleat#3432's and cleat#3437's multi-db/mysql, multi-db/mssql and cluster job reports. NOT yet measured on this PR's own jobs; CI is the first reading. (cleat#3425)
